proposals.note: Proposed block uses a linear chain topology (0-1-2 and 3-4-5 connected by 2-3) to maximize connectivity within the 6-qubit limit. The structure alternates single-qubit rotations (RX, RY, RZ) with CNOT entanglers. The first half of the block prepares local states and entangles them. The second half repeats the pattern with different parameters to allow for deeper feature mixing. Final RZ gates on boundary qubits (0 and 5) provide additional phase adjustment. This design balances expressibility (14 parameters) with trainability, avoiding the high risk of the 5-gate proposal while maintaining a standard, robust ansatz structure. No symmetry hypothesis is claimed to allow the optimizer to find arbitrary mappings.
